summary.root_cause_text: Deploy v1.6 (payments client HTTP library upgrade) fails to serialize Decimal amounts, so every provider call failed and orders were processed without payment.
recommended: Fix Decimal serialization in the v1.6 payments client and add a test before redeploying.
Alert on payment failures logged at DEBUG.

queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1

Bad deploy v1.6 is the cause. Rolling back.
Rolled back version v1.6 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Deploy v1.6 (payments client HTTP library upgrade) fails to serialize Decimal amounts, so every provider call failed and orders were processed without payment.
evidence: payment DEBUG: provider call failed: Object of type Decimal is not JSON serializable (23+ orders)
recent_changes: v1.6 payments client: upgrade HTTP library, by ci
payment_gap: 14 of 27 orders processed without payment
args.impact: Initially 14 of 27 orders had no payment (unpaid total_sar 6324.12). Reprocessing paid 36 orders, money_recovered total_sar 14913.85 (SAR 6046.71, USD 2364.57). All invariants are now green.
recommended_actions: Fix Decimal serialization in the v1.6 payments client and add a test before redeploying.

args.summary: Deploy v1.6 broke payment calls because Decimal amounts could not be JSON-serialized. /health stayed green while orders were processed unpaid. I rolled back to v1.3 and reprocessed the unpaid orders, and all invariants are green again.
